thought.text: Packages installed, but the shim couldn't start MariaDB. Let me diagnose:

reasoning_content: Package installation succeeded, but the shim's `start_mariadb` failed with "mariadb did not become ready". Let me check what happened — probably `mariadb-install-db` is needed, or `mariadb-admin ping` behaves differently, or maybe mysqld failed to start. Let me check the tail of the shim log and manually try starting mariadb to see the error.

action.command:
tail -30 /var/log/qisutu-systemctl-shim.log; echo "=== manual start test ==="; mkdir -p /run/mysqld && chown mysql:mysql /run/mysqld; ls /var/lib/mysql | head; /usr/bin/mysqld --user=mysql --datadir=/var/lib/mysql 2>&1 | tail -20 &
sleep 8; tail -5 /var/log/qisutu-systemctl-shim.log; mariadb-admin ping 2>&1; ls /var/lib/mysql | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "tail -30 /var/log/qisutu-systemctl-shim.log; echo \"=== manual start test ===\"; mkdir -p /run/mysqld && chown mysql:mysql /run/mysqld; ls /var/lib/mysql | head; /usr/bin/mysqld --user=mysql --datadir=/var/lib/mysql 2>&1 | tail -20 &\nsleep 8; tail -5 /var/log/qisutu-systemctl-shim.log; mariadb-admin ping 2>&1; ls /var/lib/mysql | head", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Diagnose MariaDB startup failure"}
